scripts.postinstall: npm install --prefix client && npm install --prefix server
scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix client && npm install --prefix server
scripts.dev: node -e "const { spawn } = require('child_process'); spawn('npm', ['run', 'dev:server'], { stdio: 'inherit', shell: true }); spawn('npm', ['run', 'dev:client'], { stdio: 'inherit', shell: true });"
scripts.build: npm run build --prefix server && npm run build --prefix client
